method: two parallel read-only whole-source reviews (processors, fetchers, LLM, models, store, scheduling; blueprints, API, templates, static assets); 'Possibly in stock' stored as in stock, the model verdict dropping changes and the decimal-comma price normaliser were spot-checked
findings: When no availability metadata exists, the JavaScript default 'Possibly in stock' (no phrase matched) is stored as in_stock=True, and a text out-of-stock hit overrides structured metadata

A model 'not important' verdict sets changed_detected=False, so no snapshot is saved while the checksum advances: the change is lost; unparseable model output counts as not important and is cached per diff; model summaries replace the diff in notifications by default
Model price and availability extraction is written into the observed restock record with no provenance; its normaliser turns 1.299,95 into 1.29995
The REST API strips observed restock values and returns snapshot file paths without hashes; backups carry no manifest or checksums

Stealth evasions, a headless user-agent rewrite, a fake desktop user agent and scheduler jitter to look less robotic; browser-step values (including typed passwords) are stored in plaintext and the share-to-cloud upload carries stored headers and step values
The stock-detection script marks the DOM before Playwright captures content and screenshots, so stored evidence carries its artefacts; snippet images are stamped with export time as capture time
The 'image_ssim_diff' processor uses blurred absolute difference, not SSIM, and a leftover 0.999 default truncates to maximum sensitivity
